findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?
findings.quote: Cloud privé souverain Hébergé dans plusieurs data centres du CTIE en mode actif-actif depuis 2016
findings.quote_english: Sovereign private cloud, hosted in several CTIE data centres in active-active mode since 2016
findings.title: Factsheet CTIE
findings.note: A 2025 government factsheet says the State IT Centre (CTIE) has its own data centres hosting the GovCloud. This replaces the Wikipedia/LuxConnect support that the checker rejected. Text was extracted from the PDF; the line order in the layout may vary.

review.reason: The government factsheet says the sovereign private cloud (GovCloud) has run since 2016 in several CTIE data centres in active-active mode, so state data centres are operating today.

findings.value_as_written: Yes: the CTIE's GovCloud, a sovereign private cloud, is hosted in several CTIE data centres, active-active since 2016
